Button.name: children
Button.description: Visible label; it is also the accessible name.

Button.name: intent
Button.description: Meaning of the action. Defaults to `'default'`; mark the main action of a view with `'official'`.

Button.name: size
Button.description: Defaults to `'medium'`. Every size is at least 32 px high, above the WCAG 2.2 minimum target.

Button.name: loading
Button.description: Operation in progress: shows a ring in place of `startIcon`, sets `aria-busy` and ignores activation, but the button keeps its look and its focus. Use it instead of `disabled`, which means the action is unavailable.

Button.name: startIcon
Button.description: Decorative content before the label, typically an `Icon`.

Button.name: fullWidth
Button.description: Takes the full width of its container.

IconButton.name: label
IconButton.description: Accessible name, e.g. `'Close'`: what the action does, not what the icon shows. Cannot be blank.

IconButton.name: children
IconButton.description: The icon. It is hidden from assistive technologies, since `label` names the button.

IconButton.name: size
IconButton.description: Square side of 32, 40 or 48 px; the icons take the matching `iconSize` token. Defaults to `'medium'`.

IconButton.name: loading
IconButton.description: Operation in progress: the icon becomes a ring; see `Button`.

CopyButton.name: value
CopyButton.description: Text written to the clipboard, or a function that returns it at the moment of the copy.

CopyButton.name: label
CopyButton.description: Name of the button for what it copies, e.g. `'Copy code'`. Defaults to `labels.copy`. Cannot be blank.

CopyButton.name: showLabel
CopyButton.description: Shows the name next to the icon. Defaults to `false`: the icon alone.

CopyButton.name: feedbackDuration
CopyButton.description: Time the confirmation stays before the button returns to rest. Defaults to `2000` (ms).

CopyButton.name: onCopyFailed
CopyButton.description: Called when the clipboard refuses the text.

Avatar.name: name
Avatar.description: Name of the person or entity: the accessible name and the source of the initials. Cannot be blank.

Avatar.name: src
Avatar.description: Image URL. Without it, or when it fails to load, the initials are shown.

Avatar.name: intent
Avatar.description: Color of the initials, on its soft container. Defaults to `'default'`.

Avatar.name: decorative
Avatar.description: Hides the avatar from assistive technologies when the name is already next to it.

Badge.name: label
Badge.description: What the badge means, e.g. `'3 unread messages'`, read in place of the visual count.

Badge.name: decorative
Badge.description: The anchor already says what the badge means, so the badge is not announced.

Badge.name: children
Badge.description: Element the badge is attached to.

Badge.name: content
Badge.description: Number or short text. Numbers above `max` show as `max+`.

Badge.name: showZero
Badge.description: Shows a count of 0, which is hidden by default.

Badge.name: invisible
Badge.description: Hides the badge, e.g. when there is nothing new.

Card.name: as
Card.description: Defaults to `'div'`. A `section` or `article` without a `CardHeader` needs an `aria-label`.

Card.name: variant
Card.description: Defaults to `'outline'`, separated by the border; `elevated` adds a shadow, e.g. for a card over other content.

CardHeader.name: title
CardHeader.description: Heading of the card; it names a `section` or `article` card.

CardHeader.name: avatar
CardHeader.description: Content before the title, e.g. an `Avatar`.

CardHeader.name: action
CardHeader.description: Controls at the end of the header, e.g. an `IconButton`.

CardHeader.name: headingLevel
CardHeader.description: Level of the title heading; pick it from the document outline, not from the size. Defaults to `3`.

Carousel.name: label
Carousel.description: Accessible name of the carousel, e.g. `'Featured reports'`. Cannot be blank.

Carousel.name: index
Carousel.description: Index of the visible slide, when the parent controls it.

Carousel.name: defaultIndex
Carousel.description: Initial slide when uncontrolled. Defaults to `0`.

Carousel.name: onIndexChange
Carousel.description: Called with the index of the slide that should become visible.

Carousel.name: loop
Carousel.description: Goes from the last slide to the first and back. Defaults to `false`.

Chip.name: label
Chip.description: Visible text; it is also the accessible name of the chip and of its button.

Chip.name: intent
Chip.description: Meaning of the attribute or status. Defaults to `'default'`.

Chip.name: variant
Chip.description: Defaults to `'soft'`. A selected chip is always a `solid` `brand` chip with a check mark.

Chip.name: disabled
Chip.description: Dims the chip and disables its buttons.

Chip.name: selected
Chip.description: Makes the button a toggle (`aria-pressed`), e.g. a filter; needs `onClick`.

Chip.name: onDelete
Chip.description: Adds a delete button after the label.

Chip.name: deleteLabel
Chip.description: Name of the delete button, e.g. `'Remove Status: open'`; needs `onDelete`.

Divider.name: orientation
Divider.description: Defaults to `'horizontal'`. A vertical divider stretches to the height of its flex row.

Divider.name: decorative
Divider.description: Hides the line from assistive technologies when it only decorates, e.g. between items that are already grouped by headings or lists. Defaults to `false`: the divider is announced as a separator.

List.name: ordered
List.description: Renders an `<ol>`, for lists whose order means something (a ranking, steps). Defaults to `false`.

List.name: divided
List.description: Draws a line between the items. Defaults to `true`.

ListItem.name: title
ListItem.description: Main text of the item. Links and buttons go here or in `trailing`, never around the whole item.

ListItem.name: leading
ListItem.description: Content before the text, e.g. an `Avatar` or an icon.

ListItem.name: trailing
ListItem.description: Content after the text, e.g. a value, a `Chip` or an `IconButton`.

StatCard.name: label
StatCard.description: What is measured, e.g. `'Revenue'`. It names the card.

StatCard.name: value
StatCard.description: The value, formatted for the locale.

StatCard.name: description
StatCard.description: Context of the value or of the change, e.g. `'vs. last month'`.

StatCard.name: icon
StatCard.description: Decorative icon at the end of the label.

StatCard.name: loading
StatCard.description: Shows a placeholder in place of the value and the change. Defaults to `false`.

Container.name: as
Container.description: Defaults to `'div'`. Use `'main'` once per page, for its main content.

Container.name: gutters
Container.description: Side padding of 16, 24 and 32 px (`compact`, `medium`, `expanded` and up). Defaults to `true`.

Stack.name: direction
Stack.description: Defaults to `'column'`; responsive, e.g. `{ compact: 'column', medium: 'row' }`.

Stack.name: gap
Stack.description: Step of the spacing scale between children. Defaults to `'4'` (16 px); responsive.

Stack.name: wrap
Stack.description: Wraps children onto new lines when a row runs out of room, e.g. a row of buttons at high zoom.

Grid.name: columns
Grid.description: Number of equal columns. Defaults to `1`; responsive, e.g. `{ compact: 1, medium: 2, large: 4 }`.

Grid.name: minColumnWidth
Grid.description: Minimum width of a column, e.g. `'16rem'`: the grid fits as many as the width allows, without media queries, and never more than one on a viewport narrower than that.

Grid.name: as
Grid.description: Defaults to `'div'`; use a list when the items are a collection, with `GridItem as='li'`.

Grid.name: gap
Grid.description: Step of the spacing scale between rows and columns. Defaults to `'4'` (16 px); responsive.

Grid.name: children
Grid.description: The cells, one per child: wrap a child in a `GridItem` to make it span several columns.

GridItem.name: span
GridItem.description: Defaults to `1`; responsive, e.g. `{ compact: 'full', expanded: 2 }`.
